lessonRef.unitTitle: PF7 — Paying Taxes and Financial Plan Capstone
lessonRef.title: Investigation or close reading: purposes and types of taxes

objective: Learners compute tax under an invented flat structure and an invented graduated structure and compare the burden at two income levels.
scenario: Perpetua is a made-up eighth grader comparing two pretend tax designs on monthly income. The flat design charges 10% of all income. The graduated design charges 5% on the first $3,000.00 and 20% on anything above. She tests incomes of $3,000.00 and $6,000.00. All rates are invented.
safetyNotes: Every amount, person, business, and account in this task is invented for practice. Nothing here refers to a real household.
Never write a real bank account, card, PIN, password, Social Security, or tax number on this sheet; the task never asks for one.
This is education, not individualized financial advice. Real money decisions belong to a trusted adult.

tasks.directions: Compute Perpetua's invented flat tax at both income levels.

prompts.text: What does the flat design charge on $6,000.00?

tasks.directions: Compute Perpetua's graduated design on the $3,000.00 income, where only the lower band applies.

prompts.text: What does the graduated design charge on $3,000.00?
What does the flat design charge on $3,000.00?

tasks.directions: Compute the graduated design on $6,000.00, applying 5% to the first $3,000.00 and 20% to the rest.

prompts.text: What does the graduated design charge on $6,000.00?
How much more is that than the flat design at the same income?

tasks.directions: The two designs swapped which earner they favoured.

prompts.text: Using Perpetua's four figures, describe how each design distributes the burden and argue for the one you find more defensible.

remediation: If a learner applies the higher band rate to all income, mark the band boundary in Perpetua's design and compute each band separately.
extension: Ask the learner at what income Perpetua's two designs would charge exactly the same, and to show the method.
